# PI HCM | Product Overview

PI HCM is a fully functional HCM based in Hong Kong and the Greater China, which provides localized pay engines, clouds and local deployment. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
